provenance.compilerVersionQualification: Not captured at bundle build; never inferred from later installed dependencies.

methodology.productScope: Core API in immutable instrumented bundles; complete process/CLI startup excluded.
methodology.cache: Warm filesystem after setup; no OS cache eviction. First invocation is not cold OS cache.
methodology.order: Sequential fresh workers; fixed per-scenario order, repeated samples reuse fixtures and accumulate transaction history.
methodology.comparison: Both PASS endpoints with complete final oracles, exact observed operation/sample identities/outcomes, equal runner/dependencies/platform/lockfile.
methodology.samples: n1 is one observation with null median/min/max/MAD/p95. n3 reports median/min/max/MAD, no p95. p95 needs at least20.
methodology.git: Actual direct positive-PID entries, observed attempts and failed attempts distinct. Total OS descendants unknown. Counter only active inside measured calls.
methodology.phaseTimings: Inclusive/nested wall durations, never additive. Missing/zero backup method does not mean no backup.
methodology.bytes: Known logical fixture payload only. Physical IO, repeated hash traffic and page-cache traffic unknown.
methodology.memory: Worker RSS sampled every10ms plus start/end; worker maxRSS cumulative, Git child RSS and shorter peaks unknown.
methodology.disk: 8GiB campaign boundary budget; 4GiB worker design budget. Neither is a physical quota or measured peak.
methodology.scale: 2/5/10Layers share100files; target owns50/20/10, respectively. OtherLayers stay active. Not a pure layer-count curve.
methodology.security: Final native HEAD/symref/semantic MAIN index/original blobs; off absences; preview metadata; B/C and interrupted/idempotent recovery in1L10.
methodology.nativeWriteTree: Recovery validation on a verified transient index may create/freshen normal Git objects; live index/refs/Layer metadata unchanged. Not used for preview.
limitations: Fixed order/cache/background/thermal confounding; no per-change ablation.
n1 deltas are descriptive, without statistical significance or distribution claim.
Representative cases, not a Cartesian matrix; no Linux or real power-loss execution.
Protect opt-in is disabled in these timing fixtures; full safety certification comes from separate suites.
No workspace traversal by this projector; all results are derived from frozen receipts and declared artifacts.
